description: This source file provides utility functions for formatting strings, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI for consistent string presentation.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and collapsing whitespace; returns original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, with special handling for apostrophes and accented characters; returns original value if not a string.
